integration_findings: AuroraDenoiser and Poziomka absent from model detection, LLMArch, conditioning and diffusion runners.
App import assumes llm.gguf and borrows shared family parts; HomeIMG must have private complete package and no accidental Qwen donor.
Backend core and libdit_engine ABI must agree; existing numeric ABI alone does not advertise new HomeIMG support. Pin a HomeIMG-capable engine and hashes, with matching core.
CPU Poziomka followed by HTP DiT is a proposed first integration, not a measured performance result. CPU expert execution still needs implementation.

Default v73 DIT_MAX_VRAM is about 2 GiB; 16 GB system RAM does not remove FastRPC map limits. Full F32 denoiser is about 4.99 GB; even F16 weight payload is about 2.49 GB before activations: graph cuts/streaming required for NPU.
Disable optional Spectrum/lowres approximations for initial parity; avoid keeping LM and DiT weights resident together.
